nodes.title: POST /api/certifications/:id/verify forwards a revoked session's Bearer to originate: the gateway's session check never runs on this route
nodes.description:
## BLUF

`POST /api/certifications/:id/verify` (api-gateway `routes/verification.ts:784`, mounted with no `authenticateToken`) forwards whatever `Authorization` the caller sent to originate's `GET /api/documents/:id` (`:788`). Measured in-process: a **REVOKED** session's JWT, alone or beside a valid connector key, reaches originate as that user's Bearer, because the gateway's session check never runs on this route. On `POST /api/documents/:id/verify` (`:488`, `authenticateToken(true)`) the same revoked JWT alone is refused 401 `SESSION_INVALIDATED`. What originate does with that token is **NOT measured**.

## Recommendation

Measure originate's `GET /api/documents/:id` with a revoked session's JWT. That sets the severity, which the gate graded Minor pending that measurement.

## Detail

* Surfaced by the #1070-#1076 gate (`2026-09-19-batch1070-1076-tier1-r1`, finding N76-2).
* Pre-existing, not introduced by that batch: api-gateway product bytes are identical at develop `51dbedd39` and at every head of the batch. `verification.ts` is unchanged at develop `f9c28a8b8`.
* How the gate measured it: in-process, the real gateway app with loopback doubles; not against a live stack or a real session store.
* Related: KS-834, the pending decision on whether this route stays public. KS-834's text says a caller who sends a token "is still scoped downstream"; this finding is that a *revoked* session's token passes the gateway here unchecked.
* Also related: the revocation property established on the authenticated mounts (KS-1207, KS-1215).
* Board search before filing (Secuura-PK, archived included):
  * literal title/description contains `certifications/:id/verify`: KS-834, KS-815 (archived, a control-byte guard);
  * `certifications/{id}/verify`: 0; `verification.ts:78`: 0;
  * `api/certifications/`: 38, none about Bearer forwarding;
  * `searchIssues("certifications verify")`, literal re-match: KS-834, KS-815.
  * None records the revoked-session forwarding.
